title: Five Spaceships
about: Building the same spaceship set piece over and over until it was finally right.
description: This track tells the story of joining Greg Baker on what became one of the longest construction projects of the week. Together we built, tore down, and rebuilt the same spaceship multiple times as Paul refined the design. What started as a frustrating task became a lesson in perseverance, craftsmanship, humor, and friendship.
lyrics: So I found Greg Baker working
I asked him what he had there,
Then asked if I could stay.
He said yes, and that was how
The longest build began that day.
Build it up, tear it down,
Then rebuild it with each other.
By the fifth one we were wondering
If the sixth was meant to fly.
Then Paul walked up, inspected it,
Build it up, tear it down,
Then rebuild it with each other.
By the fifth one we were wondering
If the sixth was meant to fly.
The first one had a problem.
At least from where we stood.
Then Paul found one more reason
Why it wasn't quite as good.
Build it up, tear it down,
Then rebuild it with each other.
By the fifth one we were laughing,
Because what else could we try?
Every time we thought we'd won,
At last the frame was ready,
Maybe it wasn't how we'd planned,
